message: Well, I don't know how it work on the "scant budget," but I would have Joseph Bruchac come.  He does Abenaki storytelling, plays flute and drum, and talks about his writing (which is amazing and wonderful).  If you haven't read his children's and young adult books, you should check out his memoir Bowman's Store.  Everyone I know who has heard him speak just raves about it.
